review_text: Very disappointing experience with eSewa support and system. I lost/damaged my old device but still had the same SIM. After moving to a new phone, the app refused to let me log in or reset MPIN/password properly. Support kept giving repeated and unrelated replies instead of solving the real issue. They even said they would send a reset link, but nothing arrived. Users are made to suffer because of poor system management and weak customer support. Be careful before depending fully on this app
